title: Bad Trips Guide, Round 56
intro: Round 56 (2026-11-24). Both of your versions are in as your checks had them. You were right about "meaningful": it was in the post, which a model drafted in parts, and I was wrong to call it a word of yours that the fidelity check held. It is now a cut you meant, and the lesson says whose a word is comes from your versions and answers, never from the check. Each point has its fate in [the record](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/main/articles/bad-trips/review/r55/RESULTS-R55.md).

Why magnesium chloride is now in your amounts paragraph: "I use it mostly because it absorbs far better than magnesium oxide, so you can see how it's helping, usually within a minute." It read [Human High in one window](https://www.pangram.com/history/af5fd4f9-ee90-40f4-8bf5-cedf55c61914) on the sixth try, the last two fixes being your ways (the two reasons apart, and "And" tying the diarrhea line to yours). The softer-peak paragraph also reads [Human High](https://www.pangram.com/history/686d3bd1-6132-4f5c-b3d9-bec01f8f8455). Every check is in [the record](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/main/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h74-20261124/RESULTS.md).

Your fixes are in the repo for every lane ([the lessons](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/main/docs/lessons/2026-11-24-1953-bad-trips.md)), and a fresh writer that never saw your versions took your second wife's paragraph to Human High from them alone ([the blind test](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/main/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h74-20261124/replay/RESULTS.md)).

suggestions.title: 1. Your amounts paragraph: why magnesium chloride
suggestions.whose: his own: his TEACH-JAW comment of round 55 ("it absorbs faster and better than any other form, so you can see how it's helping usually within a minute")
suggestions.question:
You wrote that magnesium chloride "absorbs faster and better than any other form". The study the sentence links ([Firoz and Graber 2001](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/11794633/)) found magnesium oxide poorly absorbed (4%%), and chloride, lactate and aspartate absorbed about equally well, and I found no study comparing how fast the forms act. So the guide says: "I use it mostly because it absorbs far better than magnesium oxide, so you can see how it's helping, usually within a minute", with the minute as what you see.
a) Keep it as it is.
b) Say "any other form" anyway, as your experience, in your words in the box.
c) Something else: say it in the box.
suggestions.why: it is your claim, and the source only backs part of it
suggestions.advice_note: a: it says what the study shows, and your minute stays yours

suggestions.title: 2. Your second wife's paragraph: its last phrase
suggestions.whose: his own: his TEACH-WIFE version of round 55, its last sentence
suggestions.question:
Your version is in as you wrote it. Two things about its last phrase, "since potassium gets depleted after magnesium":
A fresh reader took "after magnesium" as the magnesium causing the potassium loss, which could scare someone off the very thing you tell them to give. What you meant holds: low magnesium makes the kidneys lose potassium ([Huang and Kuo 2007](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17804670/)).
And in the API your paragraph reads [High in one window](https://www.pangram.com/history/9a72854c-b5a3-4515-a622-b4a2ae99b9b6) only with the double space you pasted after "At the hospital,"; with one space, the way a published page shows it, its last sentence reads [Medium](https://www.pangram.com/history/590654bf-e074-4d55-aa0f-3d3ea076bd37). With "since potassium gets depleted once magnesium runs low", it reads [Human High in one window](https://www.pangram.com/history/e74a7e6b-7047-4e54-af54-64070d2b5879) with one space.
a) "since potassium gets depleted once magnesium runs low".
b) Keep yours.
c) Your own words in the box.
suggestions.why: it is your sentence, and the change is one phrase of it
suggestions.advice_note: a: it says what you meant, and it reads High as the page will show it
